# Analytikerintervju Eltel Q3'26: Därför behåller vi Öka

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-11-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Redeye-style analyst interview (Inderes TV), analyst Christoffer goes through Eltel's Q3'26 report. Sales of EUR 196m came in about 7% below his EUR 212m forecast, mainly because Finnish fibre-to-the-home is slowing and Swedish smart-meter projects are winding down. Even so, the margin was the highest since 2015 at 5.6% (13th straight quarter of year-on-year improvement), and the order book jumped to a record EUR 1.7bn on large Telenor and Vattenfall contracts. Denmark/Germany is weak and the stock looks expensive on 2026-27 numbers, but he keeps his Öka (accumulate) rating with an SEK 18.3 target, based on an attractive 2028 valuation and better earnings visibility.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ELTEL — Eltel | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Inderes analyst keeps Öka (accumulate), target SEK 18.3, after Q3. Record 1.7bn EUR order book; margin highest since 2015; 2028 valuation attractive.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (Inderes). Sales missed by about 7% on weaker Finnish FTTH and smart meters ending in Sweden, but margins held thanks to efficiency gains and better pricing and indexation in contracts. New Telenor and Vattenfall contracts were not won on price and give visibility to 2028, when full run-rate is reached. The stock is expensive on 2026-27 numbers but cheap on 2028. Estimate cuts were smaller than the share-price drop on report day. Eltel still has to prove its 5% margin targe

#### Sell Triggers

- if ramp-up of the Telenor/Vattenfall contracts costs more or takes longer than planned
- if Eltel fails to show progress toward the 5% full-year adj. EBITA margin target (rolling 12m margin is 3.4%)
- if Denmark/Germany keeps deteriorating
- if frame-agreement volumes come in below customer estimates
- if Finnish fibre roll-out declines faster

> *"Tittar man på 2028 års värdering så tycker jag det ser väldigt attraktivt ut givet att man uppfyller min estimat. Det är väl där någonstans som det kokar ner till att jag fortsätter kvar på ökad"*
